channel.title: News on FIHM Group
channel.description: Recent content in News on FIHM Group

item.title: Winter Crystallography Meeting 2026
item.description: Members of the FIHM Group attended the Winter Crystallography Meeting 2026 in November – sadly without Matt.

item.title: Polar Thiocyanate Perovskites in Chem. Mater.
item.description: Maddie Geers’s work on four new non-centrosymmetric manganese bismuth thiocyanate perovskites, which combine unusual octahedral tilts with ordering of the cations in their cages, is now published in Chemistry of Materials.

item.title: Opening of Our New Lab
item.description: We celebrated the opening of the group’s new lab in the Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy.

item.title: Stronger Superexchange in a van der Waals Magnet
item.description: Our paper on enhancing superexchange through frontier orbital engineering in a van der Waals metal-organic magnet is now published in Chemistry of Materials.

item.title: A Glass Full of Magnetism in Nat. Commun.
item.description: Our collaboration with the Mínguez Espallargas Group on the magnetism of an iron MOF glass is now published in Nature Communications.
